votes.motion: Adopt Resolution R-5 of 2021 to amend the 9-Line Community Reinvestment Project Area Budget and update the Project Area Plan.
votes.description: Amends the 9-Line Community Reinvestment Project Area budget based on the terms of interlocal agreements with participating taxing entities. Includes discussion of ADU subsidy and anti-displacement policy implementation.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution R-6 of 2021 revising the Real Property Disposition Policy.
votes.description: Revises the RDA's Real Property Disposition Policy to authorize long-term ground leases as a form of land disposition and clarify circumstances in which the RDA can exclusively negotiate property disposition.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution R-7 of 2021 for the Housing Development Loan Policy Program.
votes.description: Establishes the Housing Development Loan Program Policy to provide low-cost financial assistance incentivizing development and preservation of affordable housing within Salt Lake City through a centralized application, underwriting, and approval process.

votes.motion: Ratify the determination to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location under HB5002.
votes.description: Ratifies the Chair's determination that the RDA Board will continue to hold electronic meetings without an anchor location pursuant to HB5002.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda, including appointment of Rosa Marnoto Bandeirinha to the Redevelopment Advisory Committee for a term ending January 20, 2025.
votes.description: Approves the consent agenda item appointing Rosa Marnoto Bandeirinha to the Redevelopment Advisory Committee (RAC).

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of acquisition of real property and for advice of counsel.
votes.description: Moves the RDA Board into a closed session to discuss real property acquisition strategy and attorney-client privileged matters.
